ingest.title: Send your logs
ingest.intro: This source is not collected; your application sends its logs to FaultLens. That needs an API key with the logs:ingest scope, bound to this source.
ingest.adminRequired: An admin has to create the key: Settings → API keys → logs:ingest scope and this source.
ingest.keyCreated: The key is bound to this source. Copy it now; it is never shown again.
ingest.otelHint: The otlphttp exporter adds the /v1/logs path itself. Keep the key in the FAULTLENS_API_KEY environment variable.
ingest.limits: At most 5000 records and 5 MB per request. If Kafka does not answer you get 503 + Retry-After; the client should retry.
